name: Lund University
alternatives: Prior university studies taught in English
notes: Sweden works from the national 'English 6' standard rather than a per-university band. English 6 is met by IELTS Academic 6.5 total with no section below 5.5. Individual programmes may demand more — the English master's programme asks 7.5 with no component under 7.0.

name: Uppsala University
alternatives: Prior university studies taught in English
notes: Master's entry asks IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no section below 5.5, the national English 6 standard. Individual programmes can require more.

name: KTH Royal Institute of Technology
notes: KTH follows the Swedish English 6 national standard: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no section below 5.5, for both bachelor's and master's programmes.

name: Stockholm University
notes: The general master's requirement is the national English 6 standard: IELTS Academic 6.5 with no part under 5.5. English-subject programmes set a much higher bar — the Master's in English Language and Linguistics asks 7.5 overall with at least 7.0 in writing.
